items.period: Qin/Han small-seal tradition as represented in the Shuowen seal-script style; the glyph file itself is a modern digital rendering, not an ancient artifact photograph.
items.caption: 走 in a modern digital rendering of the Shuowen seal-script form, useful for comparing the received seal tradition with later clerical and regular forms.
items.alt: A black seal-script rendering of 走 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons file page identifies the graph and script style, supplies a direct original SVG link, and reports Sinica-image CC0 provenance; this gives a sourced candidate illustrating the received seal-script stage in the form history.
items.rights: Commons file page reports the Sinica Database image as CC0 1.0; page also records Richard Sears permission terms for associated material. Verify image-level attribution during acquisition. This is a modern rendering.
